Your eleven projects 69.0 with the armband on Haaland. He sits 0.3 clear of Salah and carries a modest ceiling — 25% chance of 10 or more — but no move cleared its cost to justify a change, so hold.

You are heavy on Arsenal and Manchester City: three players in the first, two in the second. Raya, Gabriel and Saka form the spine, and Palmer joins them. That concentration is a risk, but the arithmetic didn't support breaking it this week.

Your bench is thin. Mykolenko at 3.1 is the only meaningful option if someone fails to start, and the gap between him and the rest is stark. Pope offers nothing as backup goalkeeper.

No free transfers remain, so you cannot adjust. Play the eleven as set.

Your team projects 69.0 with Haaland as captain. He is 0.3 clear of Salah and carries meaningful upside—a quarter chance of double digits, balanced against an 8% tail risk of 2 or fewer. The armband is well-placed.

You have three Arsenal players and two each from Liverpool and Manchester City. Salah at 7.9 and Palmer at 6.0 sit close enough that swapping them would barely move the needle, but you have no free transfer to explore it. Semenyo at 4.8 is your thinnest outfield starter; Anderson on the bench projects 2.9.

The bench is thin—Mykolenko's 3.1 is the best of it—so you are committed to the eleven. No move clears its cost. Hold.

Your eleven projects 60.8, or 69.0 with Haaland as captain. That 0.3 margin over Salah is slim enough to flag: Haaland carries an 8% tail risk of returning 2 or fewer, while Salah has the security of a settled role and a 25% upside to 10+. The armband is a marginal call, but the model prefers it.

You have three Arsenal players in the starting eleven and none on the bench. That concentration is offset slightly by two each from Liverpool and Manchester City. Mykolenko on the bench projects only 3.1, so you are not protected there if Gabriel or Gvardiol are rotated out, but without a free transfer you cannot hedge it.

No move clears its cost. A transfer would cost 4 points and none of your options would recover that within the week. Hold.
